request.subject: PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a chrome bathysphere submarine: the long hull becomes one round ball-shaped hull of the same polished chrome with a dark gunmetal underside; a big clear glass dome on top with a short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip, one large round glass porthole on the side, two small fins, and a row of small glowing hot magenta lights around its middle. Keep the size, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
